name: Capital Finance Holdings Limited
summary: Capital Finance Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides short-term financing services in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It offers pawn and entrusted loans, micro-financing services, financial consultancy, entrusted loan, and distressed debt assets management services, as well as money lending, administrative, and consultancy services, as well as information technology solution services. The company was formerly known as Ming Kei Holdings Limited and changed its name to Capital Finance Holdings Limited in November 2014. Capital Finance Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
